description: 東京の防災プラン進捗レポート2017 【第2部】 ◆ 震災対策(島しょ地域における地震)_2 島しょ地域における備蓄・輸送体制の確保 [fire, police and emergency services and earthquakes] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 東京都総務局. 【東京都総務局】. Coverage: Tokyo, Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 東京都総務局. It offers 20 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
